caption: The drawing features an oval-shaped metallic plaque with two circular holes on either side, possibly for mounting. The plaque is rendered in shades of brown, imitating the appearance of aged metal. At the center of the plaque, there are two early steam locomotives depicted in relief, each with prominent wheels and vertical boilers. To the left of the locomotives, the capital letter "U" is embossed, while the capital letter "F" is embossed to the right. The background is plain and off-white, with the artist's signature "ALF BRUSETT" visible in the lower right corner. The overall composition places the plaque centrally with no additional objects or decorations.
title: Firemark
